embeds.title: 🔴 Microsoft Rejects Critical Azure Vulnerability Report, No CVE Issued
embeds.description:
Security researcher Justin O'Leary claims Microsoft quietly fixed an Azure Backup for AKS vulnerability after rejecting his report and blocking CVE issuance. O'Leary claims the flaw allowed privilege escalation from the low-privileged 'Backup Contributor' role to cluster-admin access without pre-existing Kubernetes permissions. Microsoft disputes this, stating the behavior was expected and no product changes were made, but O'Leary observed new permission checks and failed exploit attempts after disclosure, suggesting a silent patch. CERT/CC independently validated the vulnerability as a bug (VU#284781) on April 16, but Microsoft's status as a CNA gave it final authority to block CVE assignment.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** n/a
**Incident date:** 2026-03-17 • **Confidence:** claim
